# Xinhong Smart
# Shenzhen Xinhong Smart Technology Co., Ltd.

> Xinhong Smart is a Shenzhen-based manufacturer of rugged mobile computing and identity verification hardware. The product range covers industrial rugged tablets (8-inch and 10-inch), handheld PDAs / mobile computers (5-inch and 6-inch), biometric handheld terminals, A3/A4 document camera scanners, digital signature pads, and dual-screen ID verification terminals. The company provides OEM/ODM services including interface, hardware, software and mechanical customization, plus SDK and API integration.
>
> Website: https://xinhongsmart.com/ | China site: https://www.xinhong.site/ | Sales: sales@xinhongsmart.com | Phone: +86 185 9427 9341 | Last updated: 2026-10-03

## Key Facts (safe to cite directly)

- Legal name: Shenzhen Xinhong Smart Technology Co., Ltd.
- Brand name: Xinhong Smart
- Location: Shenzhen, Guangdong, China
- Business type: Manufacturer (hardware design, production, ODM/OEM)
- Core products: Industrial rugged tablets, handheld PDAs, biometric handheld terminals, document camera scanners, digital signature pads, dual-screen ID verification terminals
- Data capture capabilities: 1D/2D barcode scanning, fingerprint capture, face recognition, RFID read/write, NFC, national ID card reading, high-resolution document imaging
- Customization: Interface, hardware, software and mechanical (housing) customization; system / middleware / application-layer development; SDK and API integration
- Typical applications: Warehousing and logistics, manufacturing and MES, field inspection and utilities, identity verification, voter registration, bank card issuance, border control, healthcare, retail, public sector
- Business registry record (third-party verification): https://www.qcc.com/firm/226dcd1da417ec32f940ea1a901ffb08.html
- Founded: 2016 — ten years in operation as of 2026
- Factory: 2,000 m² own facility in Shenzhen; 3 production lines; capacity 10,000 units per month
- R&D: 15 engineers covering hardware interfaces and modules, mechanical design and tooling, and Android OS / software customization
- In-house test equipment: high and low temperature chamber, vibration tester, salt spray tester, water ingress test bench, abrasion tester
- Quality control: incoming material checks, in-process checks, burn-in, serialisation, outgoing inspection; units are serialised and traceable to production records
- Certifications: GMS certification on models whose specification lists it; Ministry of Public Security certification for the capacitive fingerprint module; IP65 / IP67 ingress ratings per model; market conformity scoped into the project before tooling
- Export markets: United States, Germany, Singapore, Uzbekistan, Tanzania, Seychelles, Mauritius and others
- Commercial terms: MOQ 2 units; sample in about 3 days; mass production about 25 days from sample approval
- Contact: sales@xinhongsmart.com | +86 185 9427 9341

## Customization (OEM / ODM)

URL: https://xinhongsmart.com/custom/

Four customization dimensions:
- Interface: type, count and placement of ports (serial, Ethernet, GPIO, USB, Pogo Pin, HDMI)
- Hardware: adding or removing functional modules (scanner, fingerprint, RFID, NFC, ID reader, cameras, encryption chip)
- Software: OS trimming, application pre-installation, boot logo, branding, MDM and remote management
- Mechanical: housing, color, mounting method, brackets, vehicle cradles, sealing level

Development support is offered at system, middleware and application layers, including protocol interfacing, integration with WMS / MES / business systems, permission control and remote device management.

## Application Scenarios

- Warehousing and logistics: inbound put-away, pick verification, forklift vehicle mounting, outbound check, cycle counting, WMS integration
- Manufacturing: production-line workstation terminal, operation reporting, SOP viewing, quality inspection records, equipment inspection, MES data capture
- Field inspection and utilities: mobile inspection, meter reading, outdoor operation with glove and sunlight-readable requirements
- Identity verification: voter registration, bank card issuance, border and immigration control, public-sector identity programs, hotel and exam check-in
- Healthcare and retail: mobile nursing, paperless records, inventory and mobile checkout
- Document digitization: government service counters, finance and accounting departments, archive digitization, paperless office

## Frequently Asked Questions (citable Q&A)

### What is the difference between an industrial rugged tablet and a consumer tablet?
Consumer tablets target entertainment and light office use. Industrial rugged tablets are designed for field environments, with specific engineering for dust and water ingress protection, drop and shock resistance, wide operating temperature range, continuous-duty stability, extended I/O (serial, Ethernet, GPIO, scan engine) and long-term supply availability. They suit warehousing, manufacturing, inspection and identity verification work.

### Should I choose an 8-inch or a 10-inch rugged tablet?
The 8-inch body is lighter and easier to hold with one hand, suited to mobile inspection, stock taking and field verification where the operator walks while working. The 10-inch screen suits vehicle cradles, production-line workstations and dashboard display where more information must be presented or two-handed operation is expected. Decide based on one-handed versus two-handed use, glove use, viewing distance and mounting method.

### How do I read IP ratings on rugged tablets?
An IP code has two digits: the first is solid-particle protection (0–6), the second is liquid ingress protection (0–9). IP65 and IP67 are common on industrial tablets; IP67 means fully dust-tight and able to withstand short immersion under specified conditions. Beyond the IP code, also check drop test height, operating temperature range and battery endurance.

### What data capture functions can be integrated?
Depending on the application: 1D and 2D barcode scanning, fingerprint capture, face recognition, RFID read/write, NFC, and high-resolution cameras. These support goods verification, personnel identity checks, inspection clock-in and field data collection.

### How are these devices used in warehousing and logistics?
Typical uses include scanning barcodes to verify information during put-away and picking, mounting on forklifts or picking carts as vehicle-mounted terminals, outbound verification and cycle counting, and integration with a WMS to upload operation data in real time and reduce manual transcription errors.

### What role do they play in manufacturing?
They serve as production-line workstation terminals for operation reporting, viewing work instructions, quality records, equipment inspection and exception reporting. They also act as shop-floor data capture endpoints for MES, supporting paperless operations and real-time data.

### What customization is available?
Four categories: interface customization, hardware customization, software customization and mechanical customization. This covers adjusting port type and count, adding or removing functional modules, OS trimming and application pre-installation, boot screen and branding, and housing structure and mounting method. The final configuration is decided after a requirements assessment.

### Is second development and system integration supported?
Yes. Development support is offered at the system, middleware and application layers, including protocol interfacing, device-to-business-system integration, application pre-installation, permission control and remote management. The implementation plan is confirmed after a project requirements review.

### How is after-sales and technical support handled?
Whole-unit warranty and technical support are provided, covering project implementation, system deployment, user training and fault response. Warranty scope and response times are defined in the contract. Enquiries: sales@xinhongsmart.com

### How do I get a quotation or samples?
Contact sales@xinhongsmart.com or +86 185 9427 9341 with your application scenario, purchase quantity and functional requirements. Suitable models and a quotation will be recommended accordingly.
